summary.description: One line: what this API does.

description.description: What the API does, in business terms, and what it returns.

type_desc.description: e.g. 'string, order id' or 'number, total in cents'

calls.description: Other services, queues or topics this API calls or publishes to while handling a request.

to_service_name.description: Best-effort name of the target service/queue.

reason.description: WHY this call happens, in business terms.

data_needed.description: Specific fields/data this API needs from (or sends to) the target.

confidence.description: Your confidence that this call and its reason are correctly attributed from the evidence, 0-1.

target_kind.description: internal: another service of this same system/architecture (e.g. a bare service name, an internal hostname or env var like PAYMENTS_SERVICE_URL, a service-discovery/RPC client). external: a third-party vendor/SaaS (a vendor SDK import like stripe/twilio/boto3, a public vendor API domain, vendor-specific auth). unknown: can't tell from the evidence.

validations.description: Input validation and authorization rules enforced by this API.
